title: Conditional history-resolvent recurrence envelope
question: Can the direct R-451 history-tail input be replaced by a scalar one-step state-weighted recurrence, and what exact resolvent envelope and threshold follows without a finite-table extrapolation?

theorem.recurrence: For H_0=0, H_R <= kappa*H_(R-1) + A*r^(R-1), where kappa is a common nonnegative history-propagation coefficient and A=16*C4_edge*B^4
theorem.closed_form: If kappa != r, S_R=(kappa^R-r^R)/(kappa-r); if kappa=r, S_R=R*r^(R-1)
theorem.threshold: If 0 <= kappa < 1, then S_R tends to zero because max(kappa,r)<1; if kappa < r the parent shell rate is retained, while r < kappa < 1 gives a slower but still vanishing propagation rate
theorem.conclusion: A source-owned one-step recurrence with a uniform kappa<1 is sufficient to instantiate the R-451 all-shape Cauchy plug-in; the recurrence and kappa remain owner obligations

finite_fixture.fixture_role: Exact recurrence and closed-form identity rows only; no finite grid is used as an exhaustion surrogate

assumptions: R-451's exact two-orientation fourth-power shell envelope is available on one common L4 space or form domain.
The actual source-owned history can be summarized by one nonnegative coefficient kappa in a one-step recurrence for the total two-orientation fourth-power error.
The source term in that recurrence is bounded by A*r^(R-1), with A and r recomputed from the R-451/R-450 parent contracts.
The same kappa and source envelope hold for every nested shape pair and every history depth in the intended exhaustion.
The standard scalar fact that a polynomial factor times a base strictly below one vanishes is used only after the recurrence estimate; it is not an operator or Q3 theorem.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK derivation of the one-step recurrence and a value or bound kappa<1.
A common unbounded operator/form domain in which the recurrence error is defined and propagated.
Source-, beta-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform recurrence constants.
A proved production all-shape exhaustion map and identification of the same observable across shapes.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

adversarial_review.check: Does the scalar recurrence silently replace the missing source-owned Q3 history?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: kappa and the recurrence are explicit owner hypotheses, not derived inputs.

adversarial_review.check: Does the closed form divide by kappa-r at the resonant value?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the resonant branch S_R=R*r^(R-1) is checked separately.

adversarial_review.check: Can kappa=1 or kappa>1 be included in the vanishing conclusion?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: controls show the sufficient threshold is kappa<1; no decay is claimed at or above one.

adversarial_review.check: Could A be fitted independently of the R-451 parent constants?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: A is recomputed as the two-orientation factor times C4_edge times the parent base-tail fourth power.

adversarial_review.check: Could the radius rows be read as an exhaustion theorem?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: rows audit exact recurrence algebra only; the limit statement is conditional on the scalar threshold.

adversarial_review.check: Does the recurrence-resolvent packet replace T-054 or the additive T-059/T-061 inverse lane?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-054 admission contract and leaves the existing methods and owner order unchanged.

adversarial_review.check: Could a kappa<1 conditional envelope be promoted to common alpha, OS/GNS, physical, continuum or Clay closure?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: all downstream scope flags remain false.

evidence_level: T0 exact conditional scalar history-resolvent recurrence envelope
boundary: R-452 proves only an abstract implication: if an owner-supplied total two-orientation history error obeys a common one-step recurrence with kappa<1 and the R-451 geometric source envelope, then its exact resolvent bound vanishes. It does not supply kappa, the recurrence, a common domain, an exhaustion map, or any physical or continuum identification.
non_claims: No source-owned Q3LOCK recurrence, history coefficient or commutator estimate is established.
No common unbounded domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or production exhaustion map is established.
The conditional resolvent envelope is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
The radius rows are exact recurrence algebra and are not a finite-table substitute for an infinite limit.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
next_action: When a source-owned Q3 history supplies a uniform one-step recurrence, instantiate its kappa and source residual in this envelope and feed the result to R-451. Until then, continue the existing T-054 owner-intake boundary and the additive T-059/T-061 observation-source lock without another finite table.
stop_or_redesign: If the owner recurrence has kappa>=1, retain only the exact threshold diagnostic and record the local failure; do not relax the threshold after target disclosure.
If the recurrence residual is not bounded by the parent R-451 source envelope, keep the resolvent identity but record the source-term mismatch.
If kappa or the recurrence depends on shape, volume, cutoff, beta or history depth, do not call it a uniform Q3 estimate.
If no common domain is supplied, do not convert the scalar envelope into an operator or form theorem.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.

lean_crosscheck.role: Lean checks the exact recurrence/resolvent algebra, the separate resonant branch and the parent fourth-power decay ratio; Python checks the conditional threshold and boundary controls.
